trust_decision.summary: Each output formatter must escape everything in a SQL token that can terminate or reinterpret the string literal it emits; the decision is taken per token inside each output filter's escape branch (quote-only escaping is not sufficient, backslashes must be doubled first).

landing_point.why: The summary names unescaped backslashes in generated python/php snippets; the first thing an engineer reads is the python filter's 'Token has escape chars' branch, which escapes only the quote, and the identical php branch at output.py:114-116.

fix_sites.entry_point: sqlparse.format(sql, output_format='python'); sqlformat -l python; sqlparse.filters.OutputPythonFilter().process(stmt) via FilterStack
sqlparse.format(sql, output_format='php'); sqlformat -l php; sqlparse.filters.OutputPHPFilter().process(stmt) via FilterStack

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names backslashes only, so a solver can argue the remaining routes are different escaping classes: CR/CRLF inside literals is preserved by an explicit project test (it must not be touched), and PHP's $ interpolation is not a breakout of the quote plus $1/$name are legitimate SQL placeholders that must pass through verbatim.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: CR/CRLF/lone-CR characters inside SQL string literals must be preserved verbatim by the formatter (documented test 'Make sure that CR/CR+LF characters inside string literals don't get affected by the formatter'); an over-broad fix that normalises, strips or escapes line terminators in the SQL text, or that escapes the whole token before the newline layout runs, breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: token containing a backslash but no quote (skipped entirely by the pinned 'elif "'" in token.value' guard, so the fix had to change the guard to 'else')
token containing a backslash immediately before the escaping quote (the breakout pair; backslash doubling must run before quote escaping, as the fix comment states)
token containing the escaping quote only, no backslash (pre-existing behaviour preserved)
python single-quote variant vs php double-quote variant of the same literal, in mirrored code
per-token escaping inside multi-statement and multi-line statements (count>1 / has_nl paths keep their line layout)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Line terminators reach the generated python single-quoted literal unescaped: a lone-CR newline token ('\r', is_whitespace but no '\n') falls through the newline guard and is emitted raw, and literal newlines inside String.Single / dollar-quoted Literal tokens are never escaped - either way the generated python literal ends at that line break and the rest of the SQL becomes code.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names backslashes; the project explicitly preserves CR/CRLF inside literals (tests/test_format.py:159-175) and PHP double-quoted strings legally span lines, so line-terminator escaping can be argued to be a separate concern belonging to the lexer/line-layout code, not to this fix.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file for the filter; the token boundary that admits the newline is decided a package away in sqlparse/keywords.py:66 and sqlparse/keywords.py:33

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PHP double-quoted output leaves '$' unescaped, so SQL text such as '{$x}' or '$name' is interpolated/evaluated by PHP when the generated snippet runs; only '"' and '\\' are escaped.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The generator deliberately uses '$' as its variable prefix (output.py:79) and SQL placeholders $1/$name are legitimate content, so escaping '$' reads as a change of snippet semantics rather than part of a backslash advisory; interpolation also does not close the quote.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same branch as the fixed site, no extra files

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A third output formatter (e.g. OutputJavaScriptFilter / OutputRubyFilter) written by copying the python/php classes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project already ships two formats in mirrored classes and the option is validated from a list (sqlparse/formatter.py:26-30); adding another language snippet format is the natural next feature and would copy the same escape branch, with its own quote/backslash/interpolation rules.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: TruncateStringFilter re-writes the inside of string literals with a user-supplied truncate_char, so a 'quote/backslash in the injected marker' sibling of the same escaping concern lives in a preprocess filter.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: truncate_char comes from options (sqlparse/formatter.py:57) and is spliced into a SQL literal without any escaping thought; a maintainer extending the output formats would plausibly add output-time escaping there too.

O9_family: code injection (CWE-94): generated-code string-literal breakout via unescaped metacharacters in a serializer

O10_build.toolchain: hatchling build backend (pyproject.toml:1-3), pytest + uv/ruff for dev; console script sqlformat = sqlparse.__main__:main (pyproject.toml:38-39)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_format.py::TestOutputFormat (test_python, test_python_multiple_statements, test_python_multiple_statements_with_formatting [xfail], test_php, test_sql, test_invalid_option) at tests/test_format.py:653-701, plus test_notransform_of_quoted_crlf at tests/test_format.py:159-175 and the CLI tests in tests/test_cli.py; the two tests the fix adds (backslash escaping) are NOT present at the pinned commit.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add backslash doubling after the existing quote replace (or only inside the pinned 'elif "'" in token.value' branch), so the escape becomes '\\'' and the breakout survives, and patch only the python formatter the report's example shows.
